card.fires_on: Mostly the word 'for' (or the space) after 'sit' or 'set aside' in steps about letting vials warm up from the refrigerator. Also fires on scattered pieces of words in preparation and administration steps.

modes.label: Warm-up time wording
modes.description: The word 'for' or a space just before a stated number of minutes for vials to reach room temperature.
